jobs.description:
Summary

Estamos buscando un mecánico de servicio calificado y confiable especializado en automóviles clásicos para unirse a nuestro equipo. Este puesto implica diagnosticar, reparar y realizar mantenimiento rutinario en vehículos clásicos, incluidos autos y camiones ligeros antiguos. El candidato ideal será competente en el uso de herramientas de diagnóstico, realizar reparaciones y asegurarse de que todo el trabajo cumpla con los estándares de seguridad de la industria. Además, el puesto requiere la capacidad de asesorar a los clientes sobre mantenimiento preventivo para preservar el rendimiento y la longevidad de sus vehículos clásicos.

La compensación varía entre $37,440 y $58,240 por año, según la experiencia y la disponibilidad.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnosticar autos clásicos y camiones ligeros utilizando herramientas de diagnóstico modernas.
  • Realizar reparaciones en diversos sistemas del vehículo, como motores, frenos, transmisiones y componentes eléctricos, con enfoque en modelos antiguos.
  • Realizar tareas de mantenimiento rutinario, incluyendo cambios de aceite, rotaciones de llantas, revisión de fluidos y reemplazo de filtros.
  • Asegurarse de que todas las reparaciones y el mantenimiento cumplan con los estándares de seguridad de la industria y las especificaciones del fabricante.
  • Comunicarse con los clientes para ofrecerles asesoramiento sobre mantenimiento preventivo y cuidado de los autos clásicos.
  • Mantener registros precisos de todas las reparaciones, mantenimientos y trabajos de diagnóstico realizados.
  • Mantener un ambiente de trabajo limpio y organizado, siguiendo todos los protocolos de seguridad.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • Título de secundaria o GED.
  • Más de 2 años de experiencia en reparación automotriz, con especialización en automóviles clásicos y vehículos antiguos.
  • Dominio en el uso de herramientas de diagnóstico y reparación básica de vehículos antiguos

Experience

  • Certificación ASE (Automotive Service Excellence).
  • Más de 3 años de experiencia en reparación automotriz, con enfoque en automóviles clásicos y vehículos antiguos.
  • Experiencia con diagnósticos avanzados y técnicas de solución de problemas en sistemas de vehículos antiguos.
  • Fuertes habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con los clientes y brindarles recomendaciones de mantenimiento para automóviles clásicos.

Why Join Us?

Our innovative approach to remote mechanic jobs is reshaping the industry, offering unparalleled opportunities for skilled professionals like you. By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, leveraging cutting-edge technology to provide expert services from anywhere. With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. If you're ready to be part of a forward-thinking organization that's changing the game for mechanics, apply now and embark on a rewarding journey with us.

About Company

At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed. By embracing remote work, we're empowering mechanics to optimize their schedules, reduce commuting time, and expand their reach to serve clients beyond geographical boundaries. Through innovative platforms and robust support systems, we're creating a new paradigm in the mechanic industry, one that prioritizes efficiency, accessibility, and inclusivity. Join us in shaping the future of remote mechanics and unlocking endless possibilities for professionals in the field.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Customer Acquisition Specialist

Location: Caribbean Region

Job Level: Full-Time | Fully Remote (2-year renewable contract)

Job Summary

The Customer Acquisition Specialist at The Hive Careers is responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new clients, expand the company's customer base, and strengthen client relationships through proactive outreach. This role works closely with the marketing and sales teams to generate leads, optimize conversion funnels, support client outreach initiatives, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new customers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation: Identify and engage potential customers through various channels, including digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, networking events, and direct outreach.

Client Outreach: Conduct proactive outreach to prospective clients through email, phone calls, social platforms, and other communication channels to build relationships, introduce services, and convert leads into customers.

Marketing Funnel Optimization: Analyze and improve the customer journey from awareness to conversion, ensuring efficient processes that maximize acquisition rates.

Data Analysis: Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer acquisition and outreach efforts, providing regular reports and insights to guide strategic decisions.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

Customer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term relationships.

Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify new growth opportunities.

Budget Management: Manage acquisition budgets effectively, ensuring resources are allocated strategically to meet targets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Proven experience in customer acquisition, client outreach, sales, or marketing roles
  • At least 3-5 years experience in B2B client acquisition

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in CRM software and marketing tools
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Self-motivated with a results-oriented approach
  • Strong relationship-building and client engagement skill

jobs.excerpt: Wrike is the most powerful work management platform.
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Klaxoon — the product area responsible for Wrike’s visual collaboration strategy and the evolution of whiteboarding experiences within the broader CWM platform.

In this role, you will define and lead the strategy of Wrike Whiteboards across the key pillars: whiteboard core experience, AI strategy, vertical-oriented use cases, convergence between Wrike and Klaxoon, and customer retention. You will balance innovation, customer stewardship, product unification, and business needs while shaping the future role of visual collaboration in Wrike.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product strategy, people leadership, customer empathy, AI-native thinking, and organizational integration. You will help transform Klaxoon into a world-class visual collaboration tool while developing the PM team into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

  • Define and drive the Klaxoon strategy: Set the vision, priorities, and roadmap for Klaxoon across the core whiteboard experience, AI strategy, vertical differentiation, and Wrike/Klaxoon convergence into a single seamless product.
  • Grow whiteboard adoption and experience: Continuously raise the bar on the Klaxoon product experience to make it a world-class visual collaboration tool, with strong focus on driving adoption among Wrike customers and identifying high-value vertical use cases.
  • Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to work AI-natively, identifying where agentic workflows can change how the team operates and scales output.
  • Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers - helping them move from feature ownership to strategic product leadership while building a shared product culture across Wrike and Klaxoon.

Your qualifications:

  • Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, positioning, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs.
  • Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer expectations, product convergence, innovation, and long-term strategic direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and executive leadership.
  • People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
  • AI-native thinking: Practical understanding of AI-native product strategy and ability to identify differentiated AI use cases in visual collaboration.
  • Good UX judgment: Ability to balance product power, simplicity, adoption, and customer experience in collaborative tools.

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in visual collaboration, whiteboarding, CWM, work management, or team collaboration products.
  • Practical understanding of agentic workflows and AI-native product development.
  • Proficiency in French is a strong plus - the team is mostly France-based.
  • Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex product areas for the AI-native future.

About the Role:

  • Visual collaboration impact: You will shape the future of Klaxoon as a world-class whiteboarding and visual collaboration experience inside Wrike.
  • Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing adoption, AI, vertical strategy, customer retention, product convergence, and innovation in one highly visible product area.
  • AI-native transformation: You will help define how visual collaboration evolves in a future where AI changes how teams brainstorm, align, plan, and execute work.
  • Organizational integration: You will strengthen the link between Wrike and Klaxoon teams, products, and cultures.

What’s Next?

  • Exploratory call with a Recruiter
  • Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director
  • Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives
  • Home task
  • Final interview with the CPO

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR CV IN ENGLISH.

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

Marketing Operations & Communications Manager

About sMedia

sMedia is a digital advertising and SEO provider specializing in helping automotive dealerships boost their sales, maximize marketing efficiencies, and grow their market share. We integrate advanced technology with hands-on support to deliver dynamic, inventory-specific advertising solutions tailored exclusively to each dealership's needs.

We ground our partnerships in data, real results, and our core values: Growth, Reliability, Transparency, and Curiosity. We are looking for an accountable, strategic team member who is passionate about digital advertising and automotive retail, and who thrives on building trusting, long-term industry relationships that drive growth for everyone.

Role Overview

The Marketing Operations & Communication Manager serves as the architect and builder for sMedia’s B2B marketing engine. This role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of relationship-driven content and growth-enablement assets, ensuring that every touchpoint in the prospect and partner journey reinforces sMedia’s position as a definitive thought leader in automotive digital marketing.

This position bridges strategic planning with hands-on technical execution. Working closely with executive leadership, you will translate the corporate roadmap into highly accurate product collateral, email marketing campaigns, educational webinars, and web content. A critical demand of this role is absolute precision: ensuring all messaging adheres strictly to sMedia's brand voice guidelines and that all product descriptions reflect our exact technical mechanics. By leveraging comprehensive CRM analytics and website performance data, you will continuously optimize campaign performance to fuel our sales engine without requiring extensive managerial oversight.

  • Reporting to: Head of Growth
  • Key Collaboration Partners: Manager of Customer Growth, Market Development Lead, and Customer Success Teams.

Your Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Campaign Implementation & Execution (40% Focus)

  • Directly support the Market Development Lead by architecting relationship-driven content that builds trust with high-value prospects. This includes building, launching, and managing B2B marketing campaigns across email networks, HubSpot workflows, sMedia web properties, and corporate social channels, ensuring every asset facilitates a consultative sales approach.
  • Provide Customer Success teams with high-impact growth-enablement assets and automated nurture workflows designed to deepen existing dealership relationships and identify expansion opportunities within the current partner base.
  • Work with the Market Development Lead to draft, structure, and finalize authoritative webinar presentations and slide decks that focus on tangible dealer benefits, such as optimizing inventory turn rates to save on floor plan interest costs.
  • Organize, upload, and track all multi-departmental marketing requests inside Asana and Google Drive, ensuring cross-functional marketing initiatives launch on time and error-free.

2. Analytical Optimization & Performance Review (35% Focus)

  • Monitor and evaluate HubSpot email performance analytics, tracking delivery rates, engagement metrics, and workflow efficiency to continuously optimize messaging.
  • Routinely analyze website traffic patterns and conversion funnels using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to evaluate the health of marketing acquisition channels.
  • Draw actionable conclusions from dealership data and competitive market analysis, transforming raw metrics into clear, localized performance benchmarks to leverage across social media, blogs, newsletters, etc.

3. Brand Voice Protection & Product Accuracy (25% Focus)

  • Serve as the primary gatekeeper for the sMedia brand voice. Ensure all deployed content is direct, conversational, and authoritative, entirely free of marketing exaggerations, absolute statements (e.g., "always," "never"), or cliché automotive puns.
  • Maintain a flawless, 100% accurate understanding of sMedia’s product mechanics, proprietary features, and pricing tiers. Ensure public-facing copy correctly details how our tools operate.
  • Script, refine, and maintain the organization’s internal resource hub, newsletters, and educational case studies, simplifying complex digital concepts for dealers without sacrificing corporate credibility.

Your Background

  • 8+ years of dedicated experience managing B2B digital marketing campaigns, content deployment, and performance execution workflows.
  • 5+ years of direct automotive retail or agency experience. You must thoroughly understand dealership operations, OEM mandates, variables affecting vehicle turn, and the financial relationship between marketing spend and floor plan costs.
  • Proficient experience navigating Google Analytics (GA4) dashboards, CRM (HubSpot) marketing automation, Canva, and Asana project management software.
  • Complete fluency in reading, writing, and speaking professional English with a mastery of business communication standards.

Your Skills and Mindset

  • A driven self-starter who thrives with minimal oversight, taking complete personal accountability for the flawless execution of tasks within established operating guidelines.
  • Highly structured, detail-oriented personality focused on data over vanity metrics, possesses a continuous learning mindset to constantly identify process efficiencies.
  • A gifted translator able to take complex data anomalies, proprietary software scripts, or algorithmic features and translate them into simple, benefit-focused business solutions.
  • Intolerant of low-tier sales copy or vague buzzwords. Passionate about upholding corporate voice alignment and verifying the technical accuracy of corporate publications before deployment.
  • Confident collaborator capable of building positive, professional relationships across Customer Success, Sales, Ad Operations, and executive leadership teams.

Performance Measures & KPIs

  • Achieving a state of content execution where 95% of public-facing communications (blogs, social posts, email campaigns) require zero structural or stylistic revisions by executive leadership prior to deployment.
  • Ensuring that field-facing teams utilize marketing assets in 80% of active deals and demonstrating a clear correlation between marketing-led content engagement and overall sales pipeline velocity.
  • Consistent management of the sMedia content calendar, and execution and publication of social posts, weekly blogs, monthly newsletter, three data-backed benchmarking deliverables quarterly, and 1-2 comprehensive case studies quarterly.
  • Demonstrable performance optimization across HubSpot email communications, measured by steady increases in meaningful conversion actions and click-through metrics on digital assets.
  • Consistent marketing qualified inbound lead generation, scaling towards a target of 15+ MQLs per month.

What You'll Get From sMedia

  • Fully remote role
  • Extensive health and dental benefits package
  • 15 vacation days annually
  • 10 paid sick days available annually
  • Paid day off on your birthday
  • Time built into your work schedule for your professional development
  • Ability to make an impact and be part of a team that values feedback and cross-functional collaboration

jobs.title: Legal Document Automation Developer
jobs.excerpt: About NetLawNetLaw is a tech-enabled estate planning platform serving wealth management firms through an MSO structure.
jobs.description:
About NetLaw

NetLaw is a tech-enabled estate planning platform serving wealth management firms through an MSO structure. We power the estate planning services of an affiliated law firm, Hargrove Firm, with attorneys across 50 states delivering estate plans for the $1–50M wealth segment. We've grown 210% in the past year, are backed by institutional capital, and count multiple top 10 wealth management firms among our partners.

About the Role

We're looking for a Legal Document Automation Developer to join our team of document automation experts working on NetLaw's legal product.

In this role, you'll build and maintain automated legal document templates—including wills, trusts, powers of attorney, and other estate planning instruments—using sophisticated conditional logic to transform complex legal language into intelligent, dynamic documents.

Important: This is not a general legal assistant, paralegal, or software engineering role. We are specifically seeking professionals who have personally built automated legal document templates using document automation platforms. Experience preparing legal documents alone is not sufficient.

This is meticulous, high-stakes work. The documents you automate are legally binding instruments that protect families and their legacies. A misplaced clause, a broken condition, or an incorrect variable isn't a minor bug — it's a real-world consequence. You'll thrive here if you find deep satisfaction in getting every detail exactly right.

Success in this role depends on experience—not just familiarity—with legal document automation. We are looking for candidates who have personally built and maintained production templates containing sophisticated conditional logic, tested numerous client scenarios, debugged template behavior, and worked closely with attorneys to translate legal requirements into reliable automated documents. If your experience is limited to preparing legal documents or using document automation software as an end user, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain automated document templates using conditional logic to handle complex legal scenarios and jurisdiction-specific variations
  • Diagnose and resolve logic errors that appear only under specific combinations of client inputs.
  • Investigate unexpected document outputs and trace issues back to template logic.
  • Own template quality from initial development through testing, deployment, maintenance, and ongoing enhancements.
  • Translate attorney-drafted legal language and specifications into dynamic, logic-driven templates
  • Write and maintain template logic using IF/ELSE conditions, variables, loops, calculations, and reusable components to generate legally accurate documents across hundreds of client scenarios.
  • Rigorously test document outputs across a wide range of input combinations to verify that every conditional path produces accurate, compliant documents
  • Collaborate with attorneys, product managers, and engineers to clarify requirements — and proactively ask questions when specifications are ambiguous or incomplete
  • Document your work clearly so templates remain maintainable as the product evolves
  • Continuously learn new tools, automation platforms, and estate planning concepts as our product grows
  • Maintain production templates that generate thousands of estate planning documents annually across all 50 states.

What We're Looking For

Minimum qualifications are strictly required:

  • Direct experience designing, building, and maintaining production document automation templates used by attorneys or clients.
  • Experience with conditional logic
  • Experience systematically testing generated document output across multiple client scenarios and edge cases.

Candidates without this experience will not be considered.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience in legal document automation — building templates with conditional logic in platforms such as Contract Express, HotDocs, Gavel, Pathagoras, XpressDox, or another enterprise document automation platform.
  • Experience troubleshooting template logic involving nested conditions, repeating data, variables, calculations, and jurisdiction-specific document variations.
  • Working proficiency reading and writing JavaScript to support template logic, automation, and debugging.
  • Experience working with legal documents and legal language, with a strong grasp of why precision matters in a highly regulated field
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve subtle logic, formatting, or conditional-path defects before release.
  • Ability to work independently, manage your own workload, and deliver reliably in a remote environment
  • Experience maintaining shared template libraries or collaborating through version-controlled workflows is a plus.
  • A fast learner's mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, concepts, and legal subject matter quickly
  • Strong communication skills and the judgment to ask clarifying questions early rather than guessing when something is confusing or underspecified

Preferred

  • Exposure to estate planning documents and concepts — wills, revocable trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, and related instruments
  • Background as a paralegal, legal assistant, or legal technologist

Who Thrives Here

You're the kind of person who reads the fine print — and enjoys it. You take ownership of your work, hold yourself to a high standard of accuracy, and understand that in legal technology, "close enough" is never good enough. You're self-directed but not siloed: you know when to push through a problem on your own and when to raise your hand and ask. You're excited by the intersection of law and technology, and you want your work to have real impact on real families.

Why NetLaw

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Meaningful work — the documents you build help families protect what matters most
  • A specialized, expert team — join colleagues who share your obsession with quality and your passion for legal technology
  • Growth — deepen your expertise in one of the most sophisticated document automation environments in legal tech

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will complete a brief practical exercise focused on legal document automation and conditional logic. The exercise reflects the type of work performed in this role and is intended to evaluate real-world problem-solving rather than memorized interview questions.

The practical exercise is designed around the types of problems you'll solve in this role. No estate planning expertise is required beyond the experience outlined in this posting.

NetLaw is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary: $75k-$85k base

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a Senior Accountant as part of our corporate team that will support MAS Home Care, MAS Community Health and SPARC Services & Programs.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Senior Accountant to join our lean finance team as a key contributor. Reporting to the Controller, this role owns the full-cycle accounts payable function, treasury operations, balance sheet reconciliations, and journal entry processing. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in general accounting, thrives in a multi-entity environment, and is comfortable operating independently with minimal supervision. Experience in healthcare, staffing, or behavioral health is a plus. This is a remote role that will work in the East Coast time zone. The target salary for this full-time role is $80,000-$90,000.

As the Senior Accountant, you will have responsibility for:

Accounts Payable

  • Own end-to-end AP processing, including invoice review, coding, and approval routing in NetSuite across multiple business units.
  • Prepare and execute payment runs — checks, ACH, and wire transfers — ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and proper authorization.
  • Reconcile vendor statements, resolve discrepancies, and manage vendor relationships and escalations.
  • Maintain vendor master files, including W-9 collection, 1099 tracking, and compliance documentation.
  • Manage corporate purchasing card (P-card/Ramp) administration: statement review, coding, and policy enforcement.
  • Support month-end close by ensuring all AP accruals are posted accurately and cutoffs are maintained.

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Monitor daily cash positions across multiple bank accounts; prepare daily/weekly cash availability summaries for the CFO and Controller.
  • Process and reconcile ACH receipts, lockbox deposits, and wire transfers; investigate and resolve missing or misapplied items.
  • Manage banking portal access, payment approvals, and 2FA administration across multi-facility accounts.
  • Assist with cash flow forecasting by providing actual cash position and disbursement data.

General Ledger & Month-End Close

  • Prepare and post monthly journal entries, including accruals, prepaid amortization, fixed asset entries, and intercompany transactions.
  • Own balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts (AP, accrued liabilities, prepaids, cash); resolve aged items timely.
  • Assist in the monthly financial close process in NetSuite, including BU/entity tie-outs, transaction review, and period lock procedures.
  • Support the Controller in preparing supporting schedules and variance analysis for management reporting.

Accounts Receivable Support

  • Provide backup support for AR functions, including cash application, aging review, and collections follow-up as needed.
  • Reconcile AR sub-ledger to general ledger; assist with bad debt reserve calculations.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Ensure AP and disbursement processes comply with company policies, lender covenants, and internal controls.
  • Provide documentation and schedules in support of external audits, tax filings, and lender compliance reporting.
  • Assist with implementation of new policies and procedures (e.g., T&E policy rollout, purchasing card controls).

In this position, you must have:

  • 3–6 years of progressive accounting experience, with demonstrated ownership of AP, general ledger, and reconciliations.
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP and general accounting principles.
  • Proficiency in NetSuite or a comparable ERP (multi-entity/multi-location experience preferred).
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s, multi-sheet reconciliation models).
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities under deadline pressure.
  • Self-starter who can operate independently and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Preferred experience:

  • CPA, CPA candidate, or equivalent coursework strongly preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, staffing, or a PE-backed company.
  • Familiarity with payroll-related accounting, multi-state operations, or Medicaid billing environments.

Why You’ll Love Working at MAS:

We are a collection of high performing and highly engaged team members. We’re proud of our culture, benefits, and commitment to work-life balance, including:

  • Excellent employee benefits, including health & dental insurance, 401k with company match, and Paid Time Off
  • Opportunities to engage with fellow MAS employees through Culture, Service, and Learning & Development committees.
  • The opportunity to work for a growing company in a critical and fast-paced sector within healthcare.
Salary: $80,000-90,000

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era. As AI-driven fraud and deepfakes erode trust in digital communication, Pindrop delivers continuous identity verification and deepfake detection across voice, video, and digital interactions in real time.

Enterprises rely on Pindrop to secure billions of high-risk customer interactions each year, including top U.S. banks, as well as leading insurers and healthcare providers. Powered by models trained on more than 1.5 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents, Pindrop restores trust while reducing fraud, lowering operational costs, and improving customer experience.

Recognized by TIME as one of the Top 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, DevOps & Platform Engineering, you will lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of the teams and systems that help Pindrop build, deploy, and operate reliable SaaS products at scale.

You will own the DevOps and platform engineering roadmap across developer tooling, internal platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release workflows, environment management, observability, and cloud operations. Your work will improve developer experience, accelerate the path from code commit to production, strengthen reliability, and increase operational efficiency across the engineering organization.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a high-performing team, establish scalable engineering practices, partner across Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product, and remain technically credible in architecture and execution.

  • Define and execute the DevOps and platform engineering strategy, roadmap, operating model, and success metrics.
  • Lead the development of internal platforms, self-service infrastructure, golden paths, and developer tooling that improve engineering productivity and delivery safety.
  • Own CI/CD systems, infrastructure as code, release workflows, environment management, and deployment automation across the organization.
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product to establish clear service ownership, platform standards, reliability objectives, and scalable developer workflows.
  • Build resilient multi-cloud practices across AWS and GCP, including Kubernetes-based delivery, infrastructure automation, and operational tooling.
  • Improve observability, alert quality, uptime discipline, incident response, and root-cause analysis for critical systems.
  • Lead cloud cost, capacity, and performance optimization as Pindrop’s platform scales.
  • Remove production and delivery bottlenecks by improving platform capabilities, automation, and engineering operating rhythms.
  • Develop team capabilities, set clear priorities, manage project plans, and create a high-accountability culture that scales with company needs.
  • Evaluate and responsibly adopt AI-assisted engineering and operations tools that improve documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and team productivity.
  • Establish appropriate governance, security, and compliance practices for AI-enabled infrastructure and operational workflows.

Who you are

  • A platform-minded engineering leader: You understand how internal platforms, developer experience, reliability, and operational excellence work together to improve product delivery.
  • Technically credible: You can move fluidly between strategy, cloud architecture, platform design, and day-to-day execution.
  • A people leader: You build strong teams, coach managers and engineers, clarify ownership, and create an environment of accountability and growth.
  • An influential communicator: You align priorities, influence stakeholders, and translate complex infrastructure and platform needs into clear business outcomes.
  • Resilient and pragmatic: You exercise sound judgment in ambiguity, shifting priorities, and high-stakes production incidents.
  • A continuous improver: You look for practical ways to reduce toil, improve developer experience, strengthen reliability, and increase delivery velocity.

Your skill-set

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years of experience leading teams in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or SRE, with direct accountability for team performance and delivery.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and infrastructure as code.
  • Strong experience operating large-scale SaaS platforms in AWS, GCP, or comparable cloud environments, with a solid understanding of distributed systems.
  • Practical experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools, scripting in Python or Go, observability platforms, incident management, and production operations.
  • Experience establishing platform standards, service ownership models, reliability practices, and developer-facing workflows across multiple engineering teams.
  • A track record of improving measurable outcomes such as deployment lead time, release safety, uptime, incident resolution, developer productivity, or cloud cost efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and adopting AI-assisted engineering or operational tools with appropriate human oversight and quality controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-haves:

  • A strong foundational background as a DevOps, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or software engineer before moving into leadership.
  • Experience supporting live migrations or cloud transformation initiatives across AWS and GCP.
  • Experience building platforms for machine learning, data-intensive, security, or other high-scale products.
  • Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments or startups where speed and scale intersect.
  • Experience with developer portals, platform-as-a-product practices, golden paths, internal APIs, or service catalogs.

What’s in it for you

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how Pindrop scales and operates its cloud platform, offering direct influence over engineering productivity, release velocity, platform reliability, and cost efficiency. In an era where synthetic media, deepfakes, and identity manipulation are accelerating, our work directly protects financial institutions, enterprises, and consumers from fraud. You will wake up every day knowing your work has a tangible, real-world impact.

You will work alongside some of the best technical minds in security, AI, and voice intelligence. If you want to build something that matters—and have strong strategic visibility and organizational influence while doing it—this is that opportunity.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering teams can provision infrastructure, deploy services, and access operational information through reliable self-service workflows.
  • Developers experience a shorter, safer, and more predictable path from code commit to production.
  • Critical services have clear ownership, meaningful reliability objectives, actionable observability, and effective incident practices.
  • The organization improves delivery velocity and operational efficiency without compromising security or reliability.
  • Cloud capacity and spend are actively managed using clear data, forecasts, and tradeoffs.
  • The DevOps and platform engineering teams have a clear roadmap, strong operating cadence, and measurable impact.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer. This position is eligible for additional compensation in the form of an annual discretionary bonus.

$155,000—$185,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!

About The Role

We are hiring an Account Executive to support the client operating rhythm around Storm Ideas' Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design work.

You will work alongside senior account colleagues on accounts that are often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex. Your job is to keep the detail straight: who the stakeholders are, what was decided, what is still open, who owns the next step, and what is at risk of slipping.

The role exists because this kind of client work fails when account knowledge lives in scattered notes, private conversations, or one person's head. You will be the person who makes sure that does not happen.

You will not own the commercial relationship or set client strategy on day one — that sits with the Account Manager. But you will be close to clients, in the meetings, on the follow-up, and trusted to write things clients read. This is a role with a clear path into full account ownership for someone who moves fast.

AI is not an optional productivity trick here. You should already be using AI in real work and be hungry to get much better at it — prep, research, summarisation, action tracking, drafting, and reusable account memory.

RESPONSIBILITIES

What can you expect?

  • Maintain account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, decisions, and follow-ups.
  • Keep the operating rhythm running — meeting prep, notes, actions, blockers, and handoffs that do not depend on anyone's memory.
  • Turn client conversations into clear next steps, owners, and open questions, and flag early when something is vague or at risk.
  • Draft clear, client-ready summaries and updates that make messy work understandable without overpromising.
  • Build and maintain stakeholder maps, decision logs, and follow-up trackers that others can actually use.
  • Get genuinely good at AI-enabled account management: prep packs, account research, summarisation, QA checks, and repeatable workflows.
  • Work closely with Account Management, Creative Operations, AI Operations, and technical colleagues to keep client work moving.
  • Understand creative and operational workflows well enough to ask practical questions and explain things in plain English.

Your Expertise

  • Some experience in a client-facing, account support, coordination, or operational role — agency, media, or tech.
  • Strong written and spoken English. You can make a messy situation feel clear, calm, and practical.
  • High agency. You do not wait for every next step to be handed to you, and you escalate early when you should.
  • Structured thinking. You can break ambiguous work into inputs, outputs, owners, statuses, and next steps.
  • Real interest in AI-enabled account management. You are already using AI in your work and want to get much better at it.
  • Good client presence. Warm, curious, responsive, and reliable on follow-up.
  • Comfortable around tools such as Airtable, , Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, or Teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

What Success Looks Like

  • Nothing gets lost. Actions, decisions, and open questions are captured and easy for others to pick up.
  • Client meetings are better prepared because context, risks, and likely asks were organised in advance.
  • Clients find you responsive, clear, and easy to work with.
  • Vague asks become useful follow-up questions or clear internal next steps.
  • Account knowledge lives in shared systems, not one person's head.
  • AI becomes part of how you prepare, document, and summarise — not just how you polish writing.

This Role Will Suit You If

  • You like being close to clients and close to how work actually gets done.
  • You enjoy turning messy requests into clear, practical steps.
  • You combine warmth with structure.
  • You want to use AI to run account management better than a normal notes-and-memory process can.
  • You are comfortable working when the answer is not written down yet, as long as you can find the next sensible step.
  • You want to grow into full account ownership.

This Role Will Not Suit You If

  • You want to be a message-passer between the client and the delivery team.
  • You need every workflow, owner, and decision path perfectly defined before you can move.
  • You are uncomfortable asking clients precise follow-up questions.
  • You only see AI as a way to polish writing rather than improve how account management works.
  • You think client relationship management is mainly being polite.

Working Environment

  • Remote-first team with international colleagues and globally recognised entertainment clients.
  • Modern hardware, collaboration tools, AI-enabled workflows, and room to improve how work happens.
  • Fast-moving culture where thoughtful ideas from people close to the work are valued.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • Online video interview with short recorded answers to role-relevant questions
  • First interview with the hiring manager.

What you will do:

  • Create and manage social content for indie games across TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube Shorts, Discord, Reddit, Steam, and other relevant platforms.
  • Write copy for social posts, campaign beats, announcements, community updates, and platform-specific activations.

  • Collaborate with brand managers and producers on campaign planning, launch beats, festival participation, demo drops, trailer releases, devlogs, Steam events, and major announcements.

  • Broad gaming experience and a genuine understanding of indie games. You know what players care about, how game communities talk, and why some games become cult classics.

About Brillio:

Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technology service providers and a partner of choice for many Fortune 1000 companies seeking to turn disruption into a competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Brillio, renowned for its world-class professionals, referred to as "Brillians", distinguishes itself through their capacity to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge digital and design thinking skills with an unwavering dedication to client satisfaction.
Brillio takes pride in its status as an employer of choice, consistently attracting the most exceptional and talented individuals due to its unwavering emphasis on contemporary, groundbreaking technologies, and exclusive digital projects. Brillio's relentless commitment to providing an exceptional experience to its Brillians and nurturing their full potential consistently garners them the Great Place to Work® certification year after year.
Brillio is an AI-first technology company, backed by private equity, Bain Capital and Orogen Group, partnering with enterprise organizations to drive AI-led transformation at scale. We focus on industries where technology directly impacts growth financial services, healthcare, consumer, telecom and technology.
To make that happen, we work closely with executive teams and operate alongside our clients to deploy AI into core business systems moving from strategy to execution.

Our Team

We bring together three distinct layers of capability:
AI-Native Engineers: Engineers, Architects and Product leaders who are native to AI systems designing, building, and scaling production-grade solutions.
Leadership: Leaders who have delivered large-scale, global transformation programs — combining business insight with execution discipline
Board & Advisors: Providing strategic oversight, governance, and perspective across complex enterprise environments
What You'll Do?
Problem Discovery & Solution Design
• Engage directly with business stakeholders, VPs, clinical leads, operations owners to surface ambiguous, high-value problems and translate them into buildable AI opportunities
• Ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions, and define what a minimum viable AI solution looks like before writing a line of code
• Map existing processes end-to-end, identify where AI can eliminate friction, reduce cost, or accelerate decisions and communicate your findings in business terms
• Build lightweight scoping documents and ROI estimates that align stakeholders and set clear success criteria before development begins

Rapid Prototyping & Full-Stack AI Development

  • Design and build working AI prototypes within days using Claude and the modern AI development stack
    • Develop full-stack AI applications spanning LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, REST API integrations, and lightweight front-end interfaces
    • Own your technical architecture end-to-end from prompt design to data pipeline to user interface and be able to explain every design decision to both engineering and business audiences
    • Iterate based on real user feedback in the field ship early, learn fast, and drive toward production-grade quality with intention and speed
    • Use Claude as a core development accelerator for code generation, testing, documentation, and solution design not just as a product capability

Scaling Solutions with AI Governance

  • Partner with Brillio's AI Governance team to validate, harden, and evolve prototypes into production-grade, enterprise-ready systems.
    • Apply responsible AI principles bias review, explainability, HIPAA compliance, audit logging, and model monitoring as a standard part of every build.
    • Document solutions clearly and completely so they can be handed off, scaled, and maintained by broader engineering teams without rework.
    • Contribute to Brillio's reusable AI accelerator library turning client-specific solutions into patterns that can be deployed across engagements.

Business Rhythm & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in all client business rhythm meetings sprint reviews, program steering committees, and executive status updates
    • Demonstrate progress through live demos and working software not slide decks alone
    • Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical business leaders and build the trust required to move from pilot to scale
    • Surface blockers, dependencies, and risks early with clear, solutions-oriented framing

Client Immersion & Domain Depth

  • Develop genuine expertise in your client's business, their workflows, their data, their competitive pressures, and their regulatory environment
    • Understand healthcare operations deeply enough to generate your own problem hypotheses not just respond to inbound requests
    • Build relationships with business counterparts that go beyond project delivery, becoming a trusted advisor on what AI can and cannot do in their environment
    • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing bring learnings from client engagements back to Brillio's broader applied AI community
Must have
• 8+ years of healthcare industry experience: Direct, hands-on experience in health insurance operations (underwriting, claims adjudication, utilization management, product launch) or health system clinical and operational workflows not adjacent or observational. You must understand how these environments actually work.
• Proficiency with Claude (Anthropic) as a development tool. Demonstrated use of the Claude API including prompt engineering, tool use, and agentic patterns to build real applications. Using Claude as a chat interface does not qualify. You must have built with it.
• Full-stack AI engineering capability: Ability to build and ship end-to-end AI applications independently. LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic orchestration, REST API development, and lightweight front-end interfaces sufficient to put a working demo in front of a client.
• Demonstrated ability to prototype at speed: Proven track record of moving from a business conversation to a working AI prototype in days not sprints or quarters. You can show examples of what you built, how fast, and what problem it solved.
• Business articulation and stakeholder communication: Ability to walk into a meeting with healthcare executives and explain what you built, why it matters, what it costs, and what comes next clearly, confidently, and without jargon. This is a non-negotiable for a client-embedded role.
• Maturity to engage at the executive level: Comfortable participating in steering committees, executive briefings, and business rhythm meetings without needing hand-holding. You can hold the room, handle pushback, and demonstrate progress in terms business leaders care about.
• Ability to structure ambiguous problems: When a business leader says 'we need to reduce risk in our underwriting process,' you know how to break that into a scoped AI opportunity with clear inputs, outputs, and success criteria before opening a laptop.
• Quantitative fluency for ROI and impact measurement: Ability to build simple but credible business cases estimating time saved, cost reduced, or revenue protected and translate AI outputs into financial terms that resonate with finance and operations leaders.
Strong Preference
• Experience with agentic AI frameworks: Hands-on use of LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent orchestration frameworks to build multi-step, tool-calling AI agents that operate in real workflows.
• Healthcare data standards and regulatory context : Working familiarity with HL7, FHIR, ICD-10, CPT, and claims data structures. Understanding HIPAA requirements, CMS regulations, and FDA digital health guidance as they apply to AI system design and deployment.
• Prior forward-deployed, embedded, or startup engineering experience: You have worked directly inside a client organization, operated in a consulting or embedded delivery model, or built products in a startup environment where you owned the full stack with limited support.
• Experience shipping AI in health insurance technology company or health system: You have navigated the additional complexity of deploying AI where compliance, audit trails, explainability, and data governance are not optional and you know how to move fast without cutting corners that matter.
• Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms or accelerators: You have built solutions with an eye toward reuse creating components, patterns, or frameworks that others on a team can adopt rather than rebuilding from scratch on every engagement.
• Knowledge of AI governance and responsible AI practices in enterprise settings: Familiarity with model risk management, bias evaluation, audit logging, and enterprise AI governance frameworks and experience working alongside governance or compliance teams to get AI systems approved for production use.
Who you are?
• A builder first : you are most energized when something tangible exists that didn't exist before
• Equally fluent in the language of healthcare operations and the language of AI engineering and able to switch between them in the same meeting
• Someone who earns trust through working software, not promises you show progress, you don't just report it
• Deeply curious about what AI can do in healthcare and intellectually honest about where it falls short
• Comfortable with ambiguity, urgency, and high stakes you thrive when the path is unclear and the expectation is still high

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Aptive is seeking a full-time Technical Writer to support the Federal Highway Administration’s (FHWA) Office of Research, Development, and Technology (RD&T) at the Turner-Fairbank Highway Research Center (TFHRC). The Technical Writer will be responsible for researching, writing, and editing a wide range of technical and communications products, from one-page fact sheets to complex research reports exceeding 500 pages. This role serves as a bridge between subject matter experts and diverse audiences, translating complex engineering and research concepts into clear, accurate, and accessible content that meets federal publishing standards.

The Technical Writer role requires a self-starter, proactive problem solver and action-oriented team player with previous experience in technical writing, editing, and publication support within a fast-paced government or research communications environment. This position needs an individual that is committed to providing superior service, poised under pressure and has a positive and flexible attitude.

This is a contingent hire position. Offers will be contingent upon client approval, ability to meet security requirements, and the ability to adhere to any on-site requirements (which may change at contract award).

Remote work is anticipated. However, occasional travel for client engagements may be required.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Research, write, and edit original content for technical reports, magazine features, newsletters, fact sheets, brochures, user manuals, and other research communications products.
  • Collaborate with engineers, researchers, and subject matter experts to translate complex technical and engineering concepts into clear, accurate narratives for both technical and general audiences.
  • Provide substantive editing, copyediting, and proofreading across all stages of production, correcting grammar, spelling, style, punctuation, and logical flow.
  • Verify technical accuracy through interviews, research, and fact-checking, ensuring tables, schematics, and figures are seamlessly integrated with the narrative text.
  • Ensure all content conforms to the GPO Style Manual, the Chicago Manual of Style, and the TFHRC RD&T Communication Reference Guide.
  • Maintain compliance with Section 508 accessibility requirements and manage copyright permissions and attributions for all written materials.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of assigned documents and articles, from outline and interviews through multiple review cycles to final publication, while maintaining version control.
  • Coordinate review and approval of written materials with designated FHWA contacts and, when necessary, external stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of professional experience in technical writing, editing, and publishing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, English, Communications, Journalism, or a related scientific/technical field.
  • Demonstrated expertise applying the GPO Style Manual and Chicago Manual of Style, and ensuring Section 508 accessibility compliance.
  • Experience in the transportation sector, particularly highway or surface transportation research, is highly preferred.
  • Strategic thinker with a forward-looking approach to marketing trends and technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically.
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines.
  • Experience supporting complex projects and transformation efforts within the federal government.
  • Comfortability with supporting complex client relationships.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and time management skills.
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize, and work well with others.
  • Ability to communicate thoughts, ideas, and solutions logically both written and orally.
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to receive feedback from clients and implement changes quickly and effectively.
  • Ability to get up to speed quickly on complex issues.
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. We're hiring a Business Insights Lead to own this end to end — building the reporting infrastructure, analytical frameworks, and insights delivery that turn raw data into decisions. This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and commercial execution: you'll be the go-to analytical partner for internal leadership and the single point of accountability for external partner reporting. A year from now, GTM leaders will trust the numbers, partners will get consistent and timely reporting, and the business will have a repeatable system for surfacing growth opportunities before they're obvious.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A reporting system GTM leaders trust: partner-level insights and dashboards that give every leader timely, accurate visibility into business performance without having to ask for it.
  • An external partner reporting program running like clockwork: clear frameworks, reliable delivery cadences, and consistent data quality across every partner-facing output.

  • Recurring analytical programs — retention, cohort analysis, pipeline health — running on their own and tracking the metrics that matter most to commercial success.
  • A stronger analytics foundation for the business: closed gaps in reporting coverage, scalable self-service tools, and cross-functional partnerships that make the underlying data infrastructure work harder for everyone.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

This role calls for someone who's equally comfortable building analytical infrastructure and telling the story behind the numbers — an operator who can move from a SQL query to a stakeholder-ready narrative without losing rigor along the way.

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or insights, including 2+ years in a B2B, commercial, or GTM-facing context.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one BI/visualization tool (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Mode).
  • Experience building and maintaining recurring, full business-line reports and analytical frameworks at scale.
  • Strong communication skills — able to frame analytical findings clearly and influence decision-making across cross-functional partners and leadership.
  • Familiarity with sales performance metrics, pipeline tracking, and customer retention frameworks.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve and business context matters as much as technical skill.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in a technology, marketplace, or B2B sales environment.
  • Familiarity with CRM data (e.g., Salesforce) and how it connects to downstream reporting and analytics.
  • Experience building or contributing to external partner-facing reporting programs.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous problem statements into clear, scalable analytical outputs.

jobs.description:
Remote · Full Time · Individual Contributor · +8 Years of Experience

Staff Engineer - Client Experience

Who We Are

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. Through a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere. Agnostic by design and connected to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, Yuno optimizes acceptance rates, reduces costs, and strengthens security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction. Global brands including McDonald's, NetEase Games, GoFundMe, and Rappi run their payments on Yuno.

About The Role

Yuno is looking for a Staff Engineer to be a senior technical leader across our engineering organization — architecting the robust, scalable systems that process payments for global brands, and raising the technical bar for the teams around you. You'll take on our hardest technical problems, shape architecture and technical strategy, and turn complex, real-world payment challenges into elegant, maintainable solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll still design and build, but your impact comes as much from mentoring engineers, driving technical vision, and making the decisions that shape the platform's direction as from the code you write.

How AI Shows Up in This Role

  • As a Staff Engineer at an AI-native company, you'll shape how AI is used across engineering — architecting AI-native systems and helping define the AI-driven development practices the whole org adopts

  • AI is our default execution layer: you're expected to use AI-assisted tooling fluently across design, implementation, testing, and review, and to bring good judgment to how the team does the same

Your Contribution Will Be

  • Technical leadership and mentorship — set a high bar for technical excellence, mentor and coach engineers, and foster a culture of continuous improvement across the team

  • Architecture and system design — architect and build robust, scalable, and maintainable systems, tackling the deepest technical complexity in the platform

  • Complex delivery — drive the successful delivery of complex, cross-team projects, making sure they meet business goals and ship on time

  • Technical vision and strategy — contribute to the technical vision and roadmap, and help define and execute engineering strategy aligned with company goals

  • Cross-functional collaboration — work closely with product, design, and stakeholders, translating technical concepts clearly for technical and non-technical audiences alike

  • Quality and performance — optimize performance and scalability through efficient algorithms and clean code, and safeguard quality through rigorous testing and reviews

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6–12 months, you've led the architecture of at least one major system, become a trusted technical voice on strategy and roadmap, and measurably raised the engineering bar through mentorship, reviews, and the standards you set.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Extensive software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Go and/or Kotlin (our core backend stack) and strength across the full stack

  • A proven track record designing and building robust, scalable, and maintainable systems, with a solid grasp of architecture principles, design patterns, and best practices

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and deliver innovative solutions

  • Strong experience with AWS and cloud-native services (RDS, ECS, EKS, S3, and similar)

  • Excellent automated testing practices — unit, integration, and end-to-end — within Agile, DevSecOps, and CI/CD workflows

  • Proven technical leadership — mentoring and coaching engineers, and driving technical vision, strategy, and delivery of complex projects

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues quickly

  • English — advanced proficiency, written and spoken

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the payments or fintech industry, operating at global scale

  • Performance optimization and efficient algorithms for high-throughput, low-latency systems

  • Static analysis and code-quality tooling (e.g., SonarQube) and mature CI/CD pipelines

  • Python or other languages for data, tooling, and automation

Nice to Have

  • A track record of introducing new engineering practices or standards across multiple teams

  • Open-source contributions or technical writing that raised the bar for others

Tech Stack

  • Languages — Go and Kotlin (core), Java

  • Frameworks — Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux; Go standard library

  • Messaging — Apache Kafka, SQS

  • Databases — PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Infrastructure — AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform

  • Observability — Datadog, OpenTelemetry

  • CI/CD — GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Version Control — Git / GitHub

What We Offer at Yuno

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Remote Work — you can work from everywhere

  • Home Office Bonus — a one-time allowance to set up your ideal home office

  • Work Equipment

  • Stock Options

  • Health Plan wherever you are

  • Flexible Days Off

  • Language, Professional, and Personal Growth courses

Our Organization

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $785 million in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit

Operations Support Services (OSS) Team

The OSS Team is one of six groups within the Fundraising Operations Department, providing essential support to fundraising operations for the Member Service Bureau (MSB) cooperative. This team is responsible for triaging and responding to inquiries from Public Media Organizations (PMO) regarding fundraising operations activities CDP coordinates for the 50+ (and growing) member station MSB cooperative. In addition, the OSS Team manages logistics and provides support for MSB cooperative member on-air pledge drives. Each year, the OSS Team supports over 60,000+ hours of on-air pledge drives and facilitates the fulfillment of more than 150,000 thank-you gift orders.

As a member of the Operations Support Services team, the Fundraising Operations Coordinator will have the opportunity to learn non-profit fundraising practices and gain experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, while working to ensure a sustainable future for NPR and PBS public media organizations across the country. The Fundraising Operations Coordinator works primarily in a Salesforce CRM to assist public media organization employees with their inquiries. The Fundraising Operations Coordinator also works in RevCRM, a non-profit fundraising CRM, to manage a wide array of fundraising initiatives on behalf of our public media Clients. The Operations Support Services team works collaboratively with internal technology, marketing, and client services teams to best serve our partner stations. The Fundraising Operations Coordinator reports directly to the Senior Manager of Operations & Support Services. This is a temporary role that may lead to a permanent position based on business needs and performance.

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience preferred. Recent grads are encouraged to apply.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.
