jobs.description:
Job Opening Details:

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Bleeding Disorders News.

A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

Please note you MUST be a member of the ITP community -- patient preferred, but caregivers may apply for consideration in order to apply for this position.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire.
  • Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors.
  • Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures.
  • Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit.
  • Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner.
  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

Experience Required

  • Prior experience with writing for an audience.
  • At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with ITP.
  • Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses.

Experience Preferred

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.
  • Experienced in generating a blog or column.
  • Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to ITP.

Knowledge Required

  • Fundamentals of how ITP works.

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the ITP community.

Skills Required

  • A swift and independent learner of Internet technology.
  • A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences.
  • Time management.
  • Advanced creative writing.

Skills Preferred

  • Experience in using WordPress for content creation.
  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

  • Internet access and use.
  • Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities.

Who is Bionews?
Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

Bionews Vision
To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

Bionews Purpose
We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life.

Values: R.A.R.E.

  • RESPONSIBILITY
  • ADVOCACY
  • RELATIONSHIPS
  • EMPOWERMENT

Position Title: Full-Stack QA Engineer

Reporting Line: Reports directly to the QA Lead.

Location: Fully Remote

General Purpose: Own and continuously improve product quality by testing new features, identifying defects, creating automated tests, recommending process and product improvements, and developing strong feature and product knowledge.

Specific Objectives (~12 months):

  • Develop strong product and feature knowledge to independently test assigned product areas.
  • Deliver reliable, consistent, and clearly documented testing outcomes.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of quality across assigned product areas throughout the development and release lifecycle.
  • Support and expand automated test coverage across agreed product areas.

Key Activities:

  • Perform thorough functional, integration, API, regression, and exploratory testing of assigned features and product areas.
  • Review requirements and acceptance criteria to identify quality risks, gaps, and unclear behavior.
  • Document defects clearly, including reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for assigned product features and regression scenarios.
  • Investigate failed or unstable automated tests and improve test-suite reliability.
  • Continuously build product and technical knowledge by reviewing relevant documentation and project updates.
  • Ask timely and relevant questions to clarify requirements, risks, and expected product behavior.
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and the QA Lead to investigate and resolve quality issues.
  • Participate in release validation and clearly communicate quality risks before deployment.
  • Use approved AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate testing activities, and streamline day-to-day QA work.
  • Demonstrate active engagement and ownership of product quality throughout the development and release lifecycle.

Key Competences:

  • Strong ownership of and accountability for product quality.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong quality assurance mindset.
  • Genuine interest in the product and motivation to understand how its features and underlying systems work.
  • Ability to consider the broader product context rather than focusing only on individual test steps.
  • Commitment to improving the product and continuously developing as a QA specialist.
  • Practical experience in web application testing.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch effectively between different tasks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated tests.
  • Ability to use approved AI tools effectively to improve testing quality and productivity.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated tests (E2E: TypeScript/JavaScript with Playwright; API integration testing: Python).

Likely Current Job:

  • Full-Stack QA Engineer or Senior Full-Stack QA Engineer.
  • QA Engineer combining manual and automated testing responsibilities.
  • Currently employed by companies operating in forex, trading, cryptocurrency, or financial services.

Employer Value Proposition:

  • Take meaningful ownership of product quality while working on complex financial products and engaging features in a fully remote company.
  • Develop automation and AI capabilities through practical day-to-day application, with direct opportunities to improve testing processes and product outcomes.

Compensation: Competitive base salary with eligibility for performance-based bonuses.

Assessment Process:

  • First-stage interview with the QA Lead and Product Owner.
  • Final-stage interview with the CTO.

jobs.description:
Senior Clinical Quality & Patient Relations Manager

Reports to: Director of Quality & Safety

About the Role:

Midi is seeking a Senior Clinical Quality & Patient Relations Manager to help define how clinical quality is measured, interpreted, and improved as we scale.

This dual-function role sits at the intersection of patient safety, patient experience, and clinical quality. Approximately half of your time will be spent supporting patient complaint escalations, investigations, and resolution. The other half will focus on owning and evolving Midi’s clinical audit program, using an AI-powered chart review tool built on Claude to analyze Athena Full Encounter Summaries and identify quality signals across our clinician population.

This is more than an execution role. You will help determine what gets measured, how findings are interpreted, and what standards clinicians are held to. You will build the frameworks that others use—including our clinician coaching methodology, quality benchmarks for newly onboarded clinicians, and feedback loops between audit data and clinical practice.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Nurse Practitioner who brings strong clinical judgment, investigative instincts, and a systems-level perspective. You know when to iterate on an existing process and when the organization needs an entirely new approach.

Why This Role Matters

Patient complaints and clinical audit findings are two sides of the same coin. A complaint about clinician communication may reflect a broader pattern visible in chart documentation. A prescribing trend surfaced through an audit may help explain a cluster of patient concerns or adverse outcomes.

This role exists to bring those perspectives together and ensure neither operates in isolation.

Midi’s clinical audit program currently covers nine topic areas across 51 unique questions, with a primary focus on HRT prescribing, clinical indications, and documentation of risk-benefit discussions. You will not simply report findings—you will define what they mean, how they should be communicated, and what standard of care they point toward.

Over time, the frameworks you build will become part of the organizational standard against which future clinicians are developed and measured.

What You’ll Do

Patient Relations Support — 50%

Working closely with the Patient Relations Manager, you will:

  • Support the triage and investigation of Tier 2 and Tier 3 patient complaints, including chart reviews in Athena, AI scribe transcription reviews, and case documentation in Zendesk

  • Conduct comprehensive case reviews that integrate clinical findings with the patient’s reported experience to build a complete picture of what happened and why

  • Provide clinician-facing feedback and participate in coaching conversations for cases involving clinical quality concerns

  • Use your clinical expertise to communicate findings credibly, clearly, and constructively

  • Maintain documentation integrity across Zendesk and Athena, ensuring every case has a complete, accurate, and HIPAA-compliant audit trail

  • Identify complaint patterns that overlap with broader clinical practice findings and surface those connections to Patient Relations and Clinical Leadership

  • Provide coverage during periods of increased volume or when the Patient Relations Manager is on leave

Practice Pattern Audits — 50%

You will own and evolve Midi’s clinical audit program, including its methodology, interpretation, and application across the clinician population. You will:

  • Run pre-saved audit prompts scheduled weekly through Midi’s Chart Summary Tool, an AI-powered platform built on Claude that queries Athena Full Encounter Summaries

  • Review and interpret findings across key practice-pattern areas, with an initial focus on HRT prescribing, clinical indications, and risk-benefit documentation

  • Synthesize audit findings into clear, evidence-based summaries for Quality & Safety and Clinical Care meetings

  • Identify clinician-level and population-level trends, including outliers, documentation gaps, and prescribing deviations from clinical guidelines

  • Define and own Midi’s audit-based clinician coaching methodology, including how feedback is structured, delivered, documented, and tracked

  • Lead clinician coaching conversations independently and establish the standard for constructive, audit-driven feedback

  • Monitor audit results over time to determine whether previously identified gaps are improving, stable, or worsening

  • Connect audit findings with patient complaint data to create a more complete view of clinical quality

  • Own the evolution of audit prompts and topic areas by identifying new clinical priorities, refining existing questions, and retiring questions that no longer provide meaningful signal

  • Partner with Learning & Development to design and operationalize a structured, audit-based ramp for newly onboarded clinicians

  • Define the audit cadence, feedback touchpoints, and quality benchmarks that indicate readiness for full independent practice within Midi’s standards

Onboarding and Clinician Development

You will help build and operate the feedback loop between audit data and new clinician development.

In close partnership with Learning & Development, you will define what “audit-ready” looks like from a quality and safety perspective, including which findings should trigger routine coaching and which require a formal quality flag or escalation.

You will also help establish the cadence for reviewing new clinicians’ charts, the quality benchmarks that demonstrate readiness for independent practice, and the coaching touchpoints embedded throughout the ramp period.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Clinical fluency: You can read a chart, understand a prescribing decision, and evaluate whether a risk-benefit discussion was meaningfully documented.

  • Investigative instincts: You connect findings across systems and data sources and seek to understand why patterns exist—not simply that they exist.

  • Systems-level thinking: You can translate individual findings into scalable frameworks, standards, and processes.

  • Clear communication: You can translate clinical findings for both clinicians and non-clinical leaders and deliver feedback in a constructive, non-punitive way.

  • Comfort with AI-powered tools: You can work fluently with AI-assisted clinical tools, critically evaluate their output, and recognize their limitations.

  • Operational discipline: You manage recurring workflows reliably, document thoroughly, and keep stakeholders informed without requiring significant oversight.

  • Collaborative judgment: You understand when to coach, when to escalate, and when a finding warrants a more formal review.

Qualifications

  • Active Nurse Practitioner license in good standing

  • 8+ years of clinical practice experience, ideally in women’s health, primary care, or a related specialty

  • Experience in patient relations, clinical quality, patient safety, or healthcare grievance coordination strongly preferred

  • Familiarity with HRT prescribing and midlife women’s health strongly preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Athenahealth strongly preferred

  • Experience with Zendesk or a comparable CRM platform is a plus

  • Strong understanding of HIPAA, patient rights, and clinical documentation standards

  • Experience working with electronic health records and AI-assisted tools in a technology-forward healthcare environment

jobs.description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

We are seeking a data-obsessed, US-based Senior Growth Manager to own the post-lead, post-contact user journey for Ethos's Annuities business — and, over time, other new product lines — focused on re-engagement, retention, and maximizing long-term customer value (LTV). Annuities is a higher-stakes B2C product than our core offerings: clients are committing $250K–$300K+, the sales cycle typically requires multiple agent conversations, and re-engagement is materially more important than in less complex product lines. Your job is to design how we get prospects back into the funnel and across the finish line across every channel, without burning agent time we can't scale. You will operate as the re-engagement strategist on a shared OKR with the Lead PM, Annuities.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own the Annuities Re-Engagement Roadmap. Design and execute multi-channel campaigns to re-engage post-lead, post-contact prospects and move them along a multi-call, high-consideration sales journey.
  • Relieve Agent Load. Build interventions — email content, SMS sequences, landing pages, self-serve tools — that push clients along the funnel without requiring agent time on every touch. Agent scaling is a hard constraint; your job is to relieve it.
  • Build Across Three Modes of Re-Engagement: 1) Triggered messaging. Event-driven outbound on the right cadence and channel mix. 2) Agent-personalized follow-up. Tooling and templates that let an agent send the right three articles / dashboards / calculators after a call, fast — and that get smarter over time so the same set isn't sent to everyone. And 3) Self-serve client tools. Interactive scenario calculators, dashboards, and member-portal experiences that let clients move themselves along — comparing an annuity vs. a 401(k), modeling income, etc.
  • Lifecycle Automation. Build, test, and optimize complex sequences across channels using our CRM / Marketing Automation platforms. Partner with the offshore ops team for execution — bandwidth on ops is not the bottleneck; strategy, decision-making, and creative are.
  • Experimentation & A/B Testing. Run high-velocity tests on subject lines, send times, channel mix, offer structures, and landing-page variants. Report on statistical significance and roll out winners.
  • Data & Segmentation. Work with the Data team to build dynamic user segments. Ensure the right message hits the right user at the exact moment of intent.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 6+ Years of Experience. Senior-level track record in Lifecycle / Re-Engagement, Growth Product, or CRM at a B2C Tech, FinTech, Insurtech, or Marketplace company. Higher-consideration / higher-AOV product experience strongly preferred.
  • Multi-Channel Mindset. You think natively across email, SMS, voice / conversational AI, push, in-app, and on-page experiences. You do not believe email is the center of the universe.
  • Vibe-Coding / Hands-On Building. You can spin up your own landing pages and lightweight web experiences (e.g., using AI coding tools) to test variants without engineering hand-holding.
  • Technical CRM Proficiency. Hands-on expertise with enterprise marketing automation tools (e.g., Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, HubSpot, or similar). You build workflows without hand-holding.
  • Analytical Mindset & SQL. Fluent in Lift, Statistical Significance, Cohort Retention, and LTV. SQL is required (not bonus) — you write your own queries to pull lists and analyze performance.
  • Copywriting Chops. Subject lines that get opened and body copy that drives action — especially in a higher-consideration financial-product context where trust and clarity matter.
  • PM Collaboration. You've worked on a shared goal / OKR with a PM before and have a strong sense of when to lead, when to follow, and how to drive decisions across a cross-functional team.

The US national base salary range for this full-time position is $127,000 - $223,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Desktop Engineer

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Thoroughly and accurately understand issues and analyze problems in a systematic fashion.
  • Analyze each specific request, determine the underlying problem, and recommend proper solution.
  • Understand and execute standard escalation procedures in collaboration with tier 2 and tier 3 teams.

Collaborate with Tier 1 Support (Service Desk, Request Management):

  • Partner with front-line support teams to assist in the triage and resolution of end-user hardware, software, and peripheral issues.
  • Provide technical support on organization-wide client incidents and recurring technical problems escalated from Tier 1.

Collaborate with Tier 2 Support:

  • Coordinate on cross-ticket issues that require joint troubleshooting or affect multiple user groups or systems.
  • Engage in real-time problem-solving discussions via team collaboration platforms
  • Respond promptly to high-priority incidents and urgent escalations routed to Tier 2
  • Proactively update Tier 2 team members on the progress and status of tickets owned by other technicians, ensuring transparency and continuity of service.

Collaborate with Tier 3 Support (Cloud Infrastructure, Networking, Architecture):

  • Assist with diagnosis of Infrastructure and Networking issues and escalating issues as needed.
  • Liaise with Infrastructure Engineers, Network Engineers and Architects to support the identification and troubleshooting of Tier 3 issues.

Ticket Queue Management (Team-Level):

  • Monitor and triage the team’s shared ticket queues daily, prioritizing unassigned, overdue, or aging tickets requiring attention.
  • Reassign tickets appropriately based on technician workload, skill set, and escalation path.

Ticket Queue Management (Individual-Level):

  • Maintain ownership of assigned tickets with a focus on aging tickets and those marked as high or urgent priority.
  • Regularly update ticket status, document troubleshooting steps, and close tickets upon resolution with clear resolution notes.

Ticket Documentation and Updates:

  • Ensure all assigned tickets are updated on a daily basis with relevant status changes, technical findings, and next steps.

    Client Communication:

  • Provide timely and clear communication to end users via email or phone regarding ticket status, actions taken, next steps, and resolution details.
  • Set expectations for service timelines and follow through on commitments to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Other responsibilities assigned by management

MINIMUM SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Customer Service & Communication – Ability to respond calmly to high pressure situations and to professionally communicate with nontechnical staff, executives, and vendors.
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving – Make well thought out decisions quickly in a dynamic environment.
  • Multitasking & Efficiency – Thoroughly and accurately understand issues, analyze problems, and implement solutions in a systematic fashion.

  • Experience with MS 365 Admin Portal, Azure AD, Entra, Autopilot.
  • Experience with Mobile device support, desktop imaging, and Microsoft Teams.

  • Microsoft (MCP, MCSA) certifications preferred.
  • 3-5 years customer service-related experience.
  • 2-3 years working as a sole technical resource preferred.
  • 1-2 years' experience supporting backend IT infrastructure such as Exchange, Citrix, and Active Directory.

We are seeking highly motivated individuals who meet the following criteria:

  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • A passion for technology, problem-solving, and customer service.
  • Efficiently manage multiple tasks.
  • Contribute in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Possess strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Exhibit excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and organization skills.
  • Upbeat, friendly, motivated, and ready to help contribute to our team and the needs of our clients.

At Ascend Technologies we firmly believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not only fundamental values but also powerful drivers of innovation, growth, and success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.

CORE VALUES

  • One Team: We work collaboratively to overcome challenges with humility and respect and do what it takes to find innovative solutions.

jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who is passionate about operationalizing production AI-native and agentic workloads at scale. This is a high-impact role designed to serve as the “technical tip of the spear” for DigitalOcean’s most strategic AI-native customers and platform initiatives.

As an FDE, you will operate at the intersection of Product Engineering, AI Infrastructure, and Customer Implementation. You will partner deeply with strategic AI-native enterprises (ANEs), startups, infrastructure vendors, and internal engineering teams to deploy, optimize, and scale production AI systems on DigitalOcean’s AI-Native Cloud.

This role extends beyond traditional GPU infrastructure deployment. You will work across Inference Engine, runtime systems, orchestration frameworks, and AI-native applications to help customers operationalize production AI and agentic systems with strong focus on scalability, reliability, latency, and workload economics.

FDE engineers also act as the “first customer” for new AI-native platform capabilities. You will validate products under real-world workloads, surface operational insights and architectural gaps, and help accelerate product maturity through continuous feedback loops with Product Engineering and Research teams.

You will build scalable deployment frameworks, benchmarking systems, automation tooling, and AI starter kits that transform field learning into reusable platform intelligence and repeatable deployment patterns across the DigitalOcean ecosystem.

Your mission is to accelerate production adoption of AI-native systems while helping shape the future of DigitalOcean’s AI-Native Cloud for the inference and agentic era.

What You’ll Do

  • Strategic AI Workload Operationalization: Partner with strategic ANEs and AI startups to architect, deploy, optimize, and scale production AI and agentic systems on DigitalOcean’s AI-Native Cloud. Support complex migrations, production-ready PoCs, deployment acceleration, and long-term workload expansion across inference and runtime platforms.
  • AI Performance & Systems Engineering: Optimize distributed inference and runtime performance through benchmarking, GPU efficiency tuning, KV-cache optimization, speculative decoding, prefill/decode disaggregation, multi-node deployments, and latency/cost optimization.
  • Platform Validation & Product Acceleration: Act as the “first customer” for DigitalOcean’s AI-native platform capabilities including Inference Engine, runtimes, orchestration systems, GPU platforms, and deployment workflows. Surface real-world operational insights, architectural gaps, and scaling bottlenecks directly to Product Engineering and Research teams.
  • Platform Intelligence & Automation: Build scalable deployment assets including benchmarking systems, automation tooling, AI starter kits, deployment frameworks, operational playbooks, finetuning workflows, and reference architectures that improve deployment velocity and platform adoption.

Enable customer-facing technical teams and partner teams through validated deployment patterns, benchmarking insights, operational playbooks, reference architectures, demos, and technical guidance that help scale adoption of DigitalOcean’s AI-native platform.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 30% for customer engagements, strategic onsite workshops, ecosystem partnerships, conferences, and internal collaboration.

Key Metrics

  • Customer Adoption & Production Success: Measured by high-impact production workloads launched, reduction in time-to-production, pilot-to-production conversion rates, and expansion of AI-native platform adoption across strategic customers.
  • Platform Intelligence & Product Influence: Measured by product improvements, roadmap influence, validated customer hypotheses, and operational insights generated from real-world production deployments.
  • Asset & Tooling Delivery: Measured through adoption of FDE-built frameworks, automation tooling, benchmarking systems, operational playbooks, and reference architectures across customers and internal teams.
  • Field Enablement & Ecosystem Scale: Measured through successful enablement of customer-facing teams, ecosystem collaboration outcomes, and adoption of FDE deployment standards across the AI-native ecosystem.

What You’ll Add to DigitalOcean

  • AI-Native Systems & Architecture Expertise: Experience designing and operationalizing production AI systems including inference workloads, agentic runtimes, orchestration frameworks, and AI-native applications. Strong hands-on experience with inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, Ray Serve, NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d, or equivalent systems, along with LLM optimization techniques including continuous batching, quantization, KV-cache optimization, and speculative decoding.

Strong proficiency with Kubernetes (K8s), distributed systems, networking, storage systems, Infrastructure as Code, and large-scale AI infrastructure architectures.

Understanding of workflow orchestration, deployment systems, memory patterns, and AI-native application architectures.

  • Performance & Operational Intelligence: Proven ability to benchmark and optimize AI infrastructure with strong focus on scalability, reliability, GPU efficiency, runtime performance, latency optimization, and workload economics.

Preferred Qualifications

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Team

We are a Data & AI Architects team focused on helping customers understand what this new AI era makes possible, and what it actually takes to make the possible a reality: the right architecture, a trusted data foundation, a clear operating model, and an adoption path that scales. We work in the field, close to customers, close to our Agentforce and Data 360 sellers, and close to Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery teams. We are expected to know the domain, understand the wider ecosystem, bring a strong point of view, and help guide the architectural decisions that turn AI ambition into trusted business outcomes.

We are looking for architects who love hard problems, think in systems, and are energized by the transformation AI is driving across organizations. We value people who understand how the whole landscape fits together and where Salesforce creates the most leverage within it.

About the Role

As a Data & AI Technical Architect, you are the expert thought leader and senior field specialist for customers evaluating, implementing, and expanding their use of Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, and the broader enterprise data and AI ecosystem.

Your work sits at the intersection of technical architectural, solution engineering, applied data and AI, and delivery-aware judgment on what it takes to make a solution succeed. You help customers translate their data and AI ambitions into practical, actionable architectures. This role asks you to go both deep and wide: deep on the trusted data and agent foundation that everything else depends on, and wide across the ecosystem on which your customers actually run their business — because real architecture lives at the seams between systems, not inside any single product.

What You’ll Do

  • Share a clear point of view on enterprise data and AI — how agents, data platforms, CRM, trust, identity, workflow, governance, and adoption come together into something that delivers value through Salesforce.

  • Build customer confidence through demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, reference patterns, and architectural walkthroughs that demonstrate what's real as well as what it will take to operationalize and scale.

  • Turn what you learn in the field into reusable assets, enablement, best practices, and product feedback that extend your impact beyond your immediate teams and stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

You are a builder as much as an advisor. You are comfortable picking up new tools and technology, and are not afraid to get hands-on. You can craft and deliver an engaging story and also pressure-test the architecture behind it. You go deep without getting lost and wide without getting shallow. You bring field presence and credibility across a range of levels with your ability to effectively engage customer executives, enterprise architects, data platform owners, security and governance leaders, technical practitioners, sellers, partners, and delivery stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical architecture, enterprise architecture, solution engineering, consulting, implementation, software engineering, product development, or related work in complex enterprise environments.
  • A track record of shaping technical strategy with input from customers and /or stakeholders, validating solution approaches, and connecting business needs to technology decisions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data, AI, integration, governance, security, privacy, and platform architecture concepts and patterns.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery or customer teams to move solutions from idea to execution.
  • The ability to distill and communicate complex technical ideas to executive and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and learning velocity in emerging technologies — especially within the AI, data, automation, and agentic systems space.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, other STEM degrees or equivalent work experience. Graduate study a plus.

Helpful Experience

We care most about architectural judgment, learning velocity, and stakeholder impact. Experience with any of the following technologies and functions is a plus:

  • Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, Informatica, or the broader Salesforce Platform.
  • Conversational AI, voice-enabled AI agents, real-time voice orchestration, telephony integrations, or multi-channel service experiences.
  • Modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or RedShift, and the hyperscaler ecosystems around them.
  • AI agents, generative AI, AI governance and observability, external agent ecosystems, hyperscaler AI services, or enterprise automation.
  • Programming languages such as Python, common data structures and tooling, and AI-assisted development pipelines.
  • Building demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, workshops, reference architectures, or field enablement assets.

The Architect Who Thrives Here

You will thrive as part of our team if you seek to understand customers' real problems, not just the stated requirements. You are curious about how organizations work, where data and processes break down, where AI can create leverage, and how businesses need to evolve to succeed. You are a leader who confidently defines the what, how, and why, and challenges the status quo when you see a better path. You are excited about AI while remaining grounded in what makes it work well: trusted data, clear use cases, strong architectures, governance, adoption, and demonstrable value.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt. Aktuell hängen zu viele Entscheidungen an zu wenigen Köpfen — und unsere Account Manager:innen brauchen jemanden, der sie führt, nicht nur jemanden, der über ihnen steht.

Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.

Wir sagen offen dazu: Diese Rolle ist gerade die anspruchsvollste im Unternehmen. Du bekommst Druck von oben (Wachstumsziele) und von unten (ein Team, das sich erst einspielt). Wir wissen das, wir lassen dich damit nicht allein — aber wir tun auch nicht so, als wäre es bequem.

Aufgaben

Führung

  • Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.
  • Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.
  • Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.

Kunden

  • Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.
  • Du bist geschätzter Ansprechpartner auf der Senior-Entscheiderebene deiner Kunden und platzierst Themen aktiv in Kunden-Calls.
  • Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.

Fachlichkeit & Prozesse

  • Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.
  • Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.
  • Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).
  • Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.

Qualifikation

  1. Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.
  2. Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.
  3. Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.
  4. Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.
  5. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.
  6. Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).

Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.

Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • … du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.
  • … du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.
  • … du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.
  • … du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.
  • … du im Homeoffice Struktur von außen brauchst. Wir arbeiten vollständig remote.

jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.
  • Translate and localize text strings (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other written content) from English into Czech, ensuring linguistic accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural appropriateness.
  • Support the delivery of high-quality curated audio data that ensures clear, natural spoken output, accurate representation of linguistic and prosodic details (such as intonation, rhythm, and accent), and professional audio standards.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to develop tasks that improve AI's ability to handle speech modulation, accent variation, noise in real-world recordings, and multilingual audio processing.
  • Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Native proficiency in Czech with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2 level) with clear, natural vocal delivery and pronunciation suitable for audio recording purposes.
  • Strong auditory perception to identify nuances in speech, accents, pronunciation, intonation, and audio quality across languages.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate and localize text accurately between English and Czech, preserving meaning, tone, and cultural nuance.
  • Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.
  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, analytical, detail-oriented, and organizational skills, with the ability to articulate audio-related feedback effectively.
  • Commitment to developing AI that masters sophisticated multilingual audio capabilities.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstration of exceptional attention to linguistic nuance, auditory detail, and data quality beyond standard transcription work.
  • Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.
  • Strong command of advanced transcription and annotation practices, including handling disfluencies, accents, and prosodic features (intonation, stress, rhythm, emotion, etc) with high consistency and accuracy.
  • Background in linguistics (e.g., phonetics, phonology, sociolinguistics), speech sciences, cognitive science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated ability to analyze accent variation, pronunciation differences, and multilingual speech patterns.
  • Experience working with speech/audio datasets, annotation workflows, or AI training data, including knowledge/experience with training voice models, and an understanding of how data quality impacts model performance.
  • Experience with translation or localization workflows, particularly for software UI, product copy, or conversational AI text.
  • Professional experience in voice work, including voice acting, voice recording, podcasting with a measurable audience (e.g., X following), or similar audio production demonstrating attention to clarity and recording quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in ambiguous audio scenarios and make consistent, defensible annotation decisions.
  • Portfolio (strongly preferred for advanced candidates): Voice samples, annotated transcripts, or audio-related work demonstrating quality, methodology, and attention to detail.
  • Candidates with professional experience in voice, linguistics, speech data, or speech evaluation and research are especially encouraged to apply.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • Tutor roles may be offered as full-time, part-time, or contractor positions, depending on role needs and candidate fit.
  • For contractor positions, hours will vary widely based on project scope and contractor availability, with no fixed commitments required. On average, most projects may require at least 10 hours per week to deliver effectively, though this is not a fixed commitment and depends on the scope of work. Contractors have full flexibility to set their own hours and determine the exact amount of time needed to complete deliverables.
  • Tutor roles may be performed remotely from any location worldwide, subject to legal eligibility, time-zone compatibility, and role-specific needs.
  • For US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
  • For those who will be working from a personal device, your computer must be a Chromebook, a Mac with macOS 11.0 or later, or Windows 10 or later.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $35/hour - $45/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S.-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

About the role

Imprint's Marketing Design team builds and maintains the design systems behind a growing portfolio of partner brands — across email, web, in-app, paid, and print. Email is at the center of how we communicate with cardholders, and doing it well at scale requires both a reliable production engine and a high-quality validation layer.

We’re looking for an Email Automation & QA Specialist who thrives at the intersection of content, systems, code, and quality. You’ll be the person who:

  • Understands how emails are designed, assembled, personalized, and launched in Braze (templates, catalogs, content blocks, Liquid, localization, and tracking).

  • Builds AI automations to accelerate and standardize production.

  • Introduces an AI QA layer that flags issues early (before human review), and owns the final human QA process and quality bar.

This is a systems-and-quality role: you’ll improve and maintain our automation and QA workflows so production stays reliable as we scale.

What you’ll own

Content catalog management & template assembly (Braze)

  • Assemble new email templates from already-developed components in Braze, ensuring the final output matches the original Figma source and approved copy.

  • Build, update, and maintain reusable content blocks and catalog entries across our partner programs.

  • Manage content accuracy, localization, and versioning across a growing library of partner templates.

  • Partner with the design technologist to flag structural/component issues and improve the underlying system.

  • Build and iterate on AI-assisted workflows that convert Figma designs + copy into the content structures we use to power reusable, dynamic templates in Braze.

AI-first QA → human QA (quality pipeline)

  • Design and implement an AI QA checklist that runs before human review (e.g., link/UTM validation, Liquid variable presence, localization completeness, dark mode considerations, compliance string presence, etc.).

  • Maintain QA tooling outputs (logs, check reports, tracked issues) so QA is repeatable and measurable.

  • Conduct end-to-end human QA on every email before it reaches the lifecycle team — proofreading, link validation, rendering checks across clients and dark mode, and dynamic content verification.

  • Run inbox testing and document/resolve issues prior to deployment; continually improve the checklist based on issues found.

  • Create lightweight tools/scripts/prompts that standardize repetitive tasks and improve QA quality.

  • Own documentation, versioning, and ongoing maintenance of automations as components, partner programs, and requirements evolve.

Braze campaign & canvas support

  • Support Marketing Ops/Lifecycle with campaign and canvas builds by providing ready content catalogs and thoroughly validated templates in Braze.

  • Manage content setup, dynamic content logic, and final QA to ensure accurate and timely launches.

  • Maintain and update existing campaigns as partner programs evolve — offer swaps, compliance edits, copy updates — with automation where possible and careful review always.

Link tracking, and validation

  • Generate, manage, and QA campaign links ensuring all UTM tracking is accurate and functioning correctly.

  • Work with or similar deep linking platforms to set up and validate deep links.

  • Build automated checks to catch common tracking issues before launch (broken links, missing UTMs, wrong destinations, mismatched deep links).

Code troubleshooting & safe updates

  • Troubleshoot and make updates to HTML and Liquid code within existing email templates (within established patterns and guardrails).

  • Maintain a working knowledge of email client rendering and compatibility best practices.

  • When automation or templates hit a complexity wall, escalate appropriately — and propose systemic fixes to reduce repeats.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail — you catch edge cases and take pride in error-free output.

  • Practical experience building or operating automation (AI-assisted workflows, scripts, no-code/low-code tools, or process automation) in a production environment.

  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for email — enough to troubleshoot, update, and QA code confidently.

  • Experience with Liquid templating or similar dynamic content systems.

  • Deep familiarity with how work moves through a production pipeline: inputs → assembly → validation → launch → iteration.

  • Comfort with tooling and operational rigor: naming conventions, documentation, change control, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Clear, proactive communication and ownership of deliverables.

Preferred

  • Experience with Braze or a comparable lifecycle marketing platform.

  • Experience with content catalog management and dynamic template logic.

  • Familiarity with UTM tracking, link management, and campaign attribution.

  • Experience with mobile deep linking platforms (e.g., ).

  • Experience with inbox testing tools and client rendering QA.

  • Experience working within a component-based design system.

How this role fits the team

This role sits within the design technology pillar of the Marketing Design team, working closely with the design technologist, content strategist, and senior designers — and partnering with Lifecycle/Marketing Ops for launches.

You’ll receive finished designs and copy, build them accurately into Braze, and hand off validated campaigns to lifecycle managers. Your lane is automation + execution quality: improving how we produce emails, ensuring the system keeps working as we scale, and maintaining a consistent quality bar across every partner send.

Toolbx is the digital foundation for modern building supply teams. We provide a B2B commerce platform that transforms how independent distributors operate and engage with their customers. We're trusted by top LBM 100 dealers and major buying groups across North America. Toolbx is looking for an Account Executive with a background in B2B sales, strong knowledge of the plumbing industry, and a track record of over-achievement to support us in opening up the plumbing and PHCP market. Focusing on finding new customers, you will be responsible for establishing Toolbx as a trusted business partner with target accounts: independent plumbing wholesalers, PVF and waterworks distributors, and the buying groups they belong to. You're a natural at selling, you already know how a supply house makes money, and you have the relationships to get in the door.

This is a build role, not a maintain role. You'll be one of the first people carrying our name into plumbing supply houses, which means you'll help shape the territory, the target list, and the pitch as you go. Because we're entering the vertical rather than defending it, we're looking for someone who's spent real time in plumbing — as a distributor, a manufacturer, a rep, or selling into them — and can shorten our learning curve rather than share it.

  • Keep a clean house. Accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline hygiene in HubSpot. We measure twice and cut once here.

▌ What You'll Bring

  • Strong knowledge of the plumbing space. You've worked in or sold plumbing and PHCP — a wholesaler, supply house, manufacturer, rep firm, or a vendor serving them — and you understand how the channel works from manufacturer to wholesaler to contractor.
  • 3+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience with a documented record of beating quota.

▌ Compensation

  • United States: base salary varies by location and experience. We'll share the range for your state early in the process.

  • A proven platform entering a new market. You're not selling vaporware. Our platform is battle-tested by top LBM 100 dealers.
  • A market that's ready. Plumbing distribution is where LBM was five years ago on digital. First-mover territory, with a product that already works.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Want to work on building out security from the ground up at the leading edge of AI in healthcare globally? We're looking for a very experienced and highly motivated Staff Application Security Engineer to join our team as one of the first engineers on the Abridge Security team. In this role, you'll be a key technical leader, driving key initiatives that shape our product, infrastructure, and engineering practices. Impact both the vision and hands-on execution of our secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) across the entire product portfolio. You'll work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams to integrate security seamlessly, automate security capabilities and controls, and mentor others to build secure-by-default systems at scale in the age of AI. Conduct advanced threat modeling and security architecture reviews for complex systems, new products, and platform initiatives, providing expert guidance and requirements to meet Abridge’s security goals.

Vulnerability Management & Incident Response

Get hands on with assessing AI models, agents, and architectures.

  • Vulnerability Program Oversight: Design and enhance the end-to-end vulnerability management program for Abridge’s products and applications, ensuring timely identification, prioritization, and remediation of critical security issues while doing so in as developer-friendly a way as possible.

About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

What It's Like to Work Here:

We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.

  • Lead internal coordination for partner launches, growth initiatives, and operational execution

  • File Review & Corrective Actions: Review grant files for missing required documentation (e.g., Final Federal Financial Reports [SF-425/FFRs], SF-428 Property Reports, final progress reports) and notify the GMO of required corrective actions.
  • Closeout Reporting: Prepare comprehensive closeout packages and individual grant closeout reports summarizing financial status, resolved/outstanding issues, and recommendations for remediation.

  • Location / On-Site Requirements: Remote role based out of Washington, DC Metro area with infrequent local client interaction at agency HQ (Washington, DC) as required.

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the Friedreich's ataxia (FA) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Friedreich's Ataxia News.

A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

  • Fulfill 1x monthly deadlines as agreed upon on hire.

  • Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner.
  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

Experience Required

  • Prior experience with writing for an audience.
  • At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with FA.
  • Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses.

Experience Preferred

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.
  • Experienced in generating a blog or column.

Knowledge Required

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the FA community.

Skills Required

  • A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences.
  • Time management.
  • Advanced creative writing.

Skills Preferred

  • Experience in using WordPress for content creation.
  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

  • Internet access and use.
  • Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities.

Who is Bionews?
Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

As a SecOps Specialist, you protect Teya by detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents while ensuring our security operations are reliable, scalable, and continuously improving.

You will lead complex SOC investigations, provide L3 support, maintain and improve core security tooling, and build automations and integrations that increase speed, consistency, and quality across security operations.

You will work closely with Security Engineering, IT, Infrastructure, Platform, Cloud, and Product teams to reduce risk and embed security effectively across the organisation.

You operate across incident response, detection engineering, security tooling, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, telemetry, and automation - turning operational insight into stronger controls and better engineering outcomes.

Responsibilities

Security Operations & Incident Response

• Lead end-to-end investigation and response of complex security incidents.

• Act as L3 escalation point for SOC analysts and MSSP.

• Coordinate across Security, Engineering, IT, Cloud, Legal, and Compliance during

incidents.

• Make clear, risk-based decisions under pressure with strong documentation.

• Maintain playbooks, runbooks, and incident workflows.

• Drive post-incident reviews and ensure improvements are implemented and follow-ups

completed.

• Support incident metrics (MTTD, MTTR, recurrence, etc.)

SOC Tooling & Platform Operations

• Operate and improve SIEM, EDR, email security, case management, and vulnerability

tools.

• Monitor health, coverage, data quality, and integrations.

• Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, API, and configuration issues.

• Build and maintain integrations between security tools and internal systems.

• Manage upgrades, changes, access reviews, and documentation.

• Apply engineering practices (version control, testing, peer review, rollback).

• Reduce operational toil through automation and simplification.

Vulnerability Management

• Analyse and prioritise vulnerabilities based on risk and exploitability.

• Work with Engineering and IT to drive remediation.

• Track fixes, validate resolution, and escalate high-risk issues.

• Improve vulnerability workflows and automation.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend preventative controls.

Detection Engineering

• Build, test, and maintain detection rules, queries, and correlation logic.

• Manage full detection lifecycle (build → test → tune → measure → retire).

• Use version control and detection-as-code where possible.

• Reduce false positives and improve detection quality and coverage.

• Map detections to threat behaviours (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK).

• Validate detections through testing, incidents, and simulations.

Log & Telemetry Management

• Onboard and maintain log sources across cloud, identity, endpoint, network, and SaaS.

• Ensure logs are complete, reliable, and usable for detection and investigation.

• Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, schema, and data quality issues.

• Build validation and monitoring for telemetry pipelines.

• Offboard unused sources safely with documented impact.

• Improve telemetry coverage by working with engineering teams.

Threat Intelligence

• Monitor threats, vulnerabilities, and attacker techniques.

• Translate intelligence into detections, investigations, and remediation actions.

• Assess relevance to Teya’s environment and risk profile.

• Share actionable insights with relevant teams.

• Improve security posture using trends and intelligence.

• Gather and utilize intelligence for Shadow AI use-cases.

Cross-Functional Delivery

• Partner with Engineering and Platform teams on security requirements.

• Manage security work in Jira with clear scope and ownership.

• Support security projects (tooling, integrations, telemetry, controls).

• Contribute to technical design discussions.

• Produce clear technical documentation and workflows.

• Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Automation & Engineering

• Automate SOC and security operations workflows.

• Build scripts, integrations, and event-driven automations using APIs and cloud services.

• Apply secure engineering practices (testing, logging, secrets management, error

handling).

• Use version control and peer review for automation and detection content.

• Monitor and improve automation reliability.

• Explore AI/automation opportunities to reduce manual effort.

• Define and track operational and security metrics.

Requirements

• 7+ years in SOC, incident response, detection engineering, or security engineering.

• Experience leading complex security incidents end-to-end.

• Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, and security tooling.

• Experience building and tuning detections and queries.

• Experience with log onboarding, telemetry pipelines, and data quality issues.

• Strong vulnerability management and remediation experience.

• Solid understanding of attack techniques, cloud, endpoint, identity, and network security.

• Hands-on scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, etc.).

• Experience with APIs, integrations, and automation workflows.

• Familiarity with Git and engineering practices (testing, review, deployment).

• Experience using Jira or similar tools for operational delivery.

• Strong communication and documentation skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

Nice-to-Haves

• Fintech or regulated industry experience.

• AWS or cloud-native security experience.

• Experience with tools like Exabeam, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Okta, etc.

• SOAR or security automation experience.

• Threat hunting, purple teaming, or detection-as-code experience.

• CI/CD, IaC, or DevSecOps exposure.

• REST APIs, OAuth, secrets management experience.

• Security certifications (GCIA, GCIH, CISSP, etc.).

Ways of Working

• Ownership: You own outcomes, not just tasks.

• Calm under pressure: You stay structured in incidents.

• Risk-based thinking: You prioritise what reduces real risk.

• Engineering mindset: You build scalable, maintainable solutions.

• Collaboration: You work effectively across teams.

• Curiosity: You dig into root causes and system behaviour.

• Autonomy: You operate independently but escalate appropriately.

• Impact-driven: You focus on measurable security improvement.

• High craft standard: You value quality in detections, tooling, and documentation.

• Reuse over reinvention: You build for scale and repeatability.

• Continuous learning: You stay current with threats and technology.

• AI-aware: You look for safe, practical AI first automation opportunitie

The Perks

  • Health Insurance;

  • Possibility to visit other Teya offices to meet colleagues in instances when travel is safe and appropriate;

  • Friday lunch in the office;

  • Friendly, comfortable and high-end work equipment and informal office environment;

  • Hybrid work mode policy.
